modelDescription: The X-Bolt 2 Speed Long Range SR features the Vari-Tech composite stock and is adjustable for length of pull, comb height and grip angle for a personalized fit to the rifle; redesigned receiver and bolt; fluted sporter-weight barrel with belled muzzle and radial muzzle brake; Plus Magazine System and Cerakote finish.
